sources.snippet: ML-Agents Overview ML-Agents enable games and simulations to serve as environments for training intelligent agents in Unity. Training can be done with reinforcement learning, imitation learning, neuroevolution, or any other methods. Trained agents can be used for many use cases, including controlling NPC behavior (in a variety of settings such as multi-agent and adversarial), automated testing ...
